info.title: API.SH: CoinMarketCap
info.description: The CoinMarketCap API from API.SH: public CoinMarketCap data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Every CoinMarketCap category (sector) with its rank, market cap, 24 h volume, dominance, gainers and losers count, market-cap change and average price change over 1 h to all time, and its top coins. Sort with `sort`; filter by name with `q`. Use `slug` with /coinmarketcap/v1/listings `tag` for the coins in a category.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 2 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coinmarketcap-categories

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default rank).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only categories whose name or slug contains this text.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows to return, up to 1000 (default all).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One cryptocurrency on CoinMarketCap: description, category, tags, dates (added, launched), launch price, watchlist count; USD price, market cap, fully diluted cap, dominance, volume (24 h, 7 d, 30 d, CEX and DEX split), supply, ROI, price change for 1 h, 24 h, 7 d, 30 d, 60 d, 90 d, 1 y, YTD and all time, low/high ranges (24 h, 7 d, 30 d, 90 d, 52 w), all-time high and low with dates, yesterday's OHLCV, contract addresses per chain and links (website, whitepaper, explorers, source code, socials).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coinmarketcap-coin

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Coin slug as in the coin's URL, e.g. `bitcoin`, `ethereum`, `solana`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: CoinMarketCap id, e.g. `1` (Bitcoin).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A coinmarketcap.com/currencies/<slug>/ link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Where a coin trades: exchange, pair, category (spot, perpetual, futures), trade link, USD price and quote price, 24 h volume (USD, base, quote) and share of volume, +/-2% depth in USD, effective liquidity, market score, fee type, verified and outlier flags. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coinmarketcap-coin-markets

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Coin slug, e.g. `bitcoin` (or pass id or url).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: CoinMarketCap id.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A coinmarketcap.com/currencies/<slug>/ link.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: spot (default), perpetual or futures.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: cmc_rank_advanced (default), volume_24h, price, effective_liquidity or market_score.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Markets per page, 1-100 (default 50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One exchange on CoinMarketCap: description, launch date, countries, fiat currencies, tags, maker/taker fees, net worth of reserves, spot/perpetual/futures volume, open interest, verified volume, DEX liquidity and links. `markets=1` adds its markets (same fields as /coinmarketcap/v1/coin-markets) paged with `category`, `sort`, `page`, `limit`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coinmarketcap-exchange

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Exchange slug as in its URL, e.g. `binance`, `coinbase-exchange`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A coinmarketcap.com/exchanges/<slug>/ link.

parameters.name: markets
parameters.description: true adds the exchange's markets.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: With markets: spot (default), perpetual or futures.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: With markets: volume_24h (default), cmc_rank_advanced, price, effective_liquidity or market_score.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: With markets: page number.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: With markets: markets per page, 1-100 (default 50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: CoinMarketCap global metrics and Fear & Greed
get.description:
Global crypto metrics from CoinMarketCap: total market cap and volume with 24 h change, altcoin market cap, BTC and ETH dominance, DeFi, stablecoin and derivatives figures, counts of coins, DEX tokens, new tokens, market pairs and exchanges, Ethereum gas, and the CMC Fear & Greed index (today and a daily history).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coinmarketcap-global

parameters.name: fear_greed_days
parameters.description: Days of Fear & Greed history, 0-365 (default 30).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Daily or hourly OHLCV of a coin between two dates: open, high, low, close, volume, market cap and circulating supply, with the times of the period's high and low, converted to the chosen currency. Daily spans up to 400 days per call, hourly up to 31 days (default: the last 30 days, or 2 days hourly).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coinmarketcap-historical

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Coin slug, e.g. `bitcoin` (or pass id or url).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: CoinMarketCap id, e.g. `1`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A coinmarketcap.com/currencies/<slug>/ link.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start date (ISO or unix seconds).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: End date (ISO or unix seconds; default now).

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: 1d (default) or 1h.

parameters.name: convert
parameters.description: Currency (default USD): USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, INR, CNY, KRW, AUD, CAD, CHF, BRL, RUB, TRY, HKD, SGD, IDR, MXN, ZAR, SEK, NOK, PLN, NGN, AED, SAR, VND, BTC, ETH, BNB, SOL, SATS.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Cryptocurrencies ranked on CoinMarketCap: id, rank, name, symbol, slug, logo, price, market cap, 24 h volume, 1 h/24 h/7 d change, circulating/total/max supply, all-time high and low, 24 h high and low, number of market pairs, tags, platform (for tokens), date added, plus `quotes` with every requested currency (price, market cap, fully diluted cap, volume 24 h/7 d/30 d, change 1 h to 1 y and YTD, dominance, turnover). Sort by any column, filter coins vs tokens, by tag, by one or several tags (categories), by network, by the exchanges that list the coin, by days since it was added, by ranges of market cap, fully diluted value, price, 24 h volume, 24 h volume change, 24 h change and circulating supply, and to audited projects (applied filters are echoed in `filters`). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coinmarketcap-listings

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort column (default market_cap).

parameters.name: sort_dir
parameters.description: desc (default; asc for name) or asc.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: all (default), coins or tokens.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Tag (category) slug, e.g. `memes`, `defi`, `layer-1`, `ai-big-data`, `stablecoin`; up to 10 comma-separated for coins carrying any of them.

parameters.name: convert
parameters.description: Up to 3 comma-separated currencies for `quotes`, e.g. `USD,EUR,BTC` (default USD).

parameters.name: market_cap_min
parameters.description: Only coins with at least this market cap (USD).

parameters.name: market_cap_max
parameters.description: Only coins with at most this market cap (USD).

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Only coins priced at least this (USD).

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Only coins priced at most this (USD).

parameters.name: volume_24h_min
parameters.description: Only coins with at least this 24 h volume (USD).

parameters.name: volume_24h_max
parameters.description: Only coins with at most this 24 h volume (USD).

parameters.name: percent_change_24h_min
parameters.description: Only coins whose 24 h change is at least this percentage, e.g. `5` or `-10`.

parameters.name: percent_change_24h_max
parameters.description: Only coins whose 24 h change is at most this percentage.

parameters.name: circulating_supply_min
parameters.description: Only coins with at least this circulating supply.

parameters.name: circulating_supply_max
parameters.description: Only coins with at most this circulating supply.

parameters.name: fdv_min
parameters.description: Only coins with at least this fully diluted value (USD).

parameters.name: fdv_max
parameters.description: Only coins with at most this fully diluted value (USD).

parameters.name: volume_change_24h_min
parameters.description: Only coins whose 24 h volume changed at least this percentage.

parameters.name: volume_change_24h_max
parameters.description: Only coins whose 24 h volume changed at most this percentage.

parameters.name: platform_id
parameters.description: Only tokens on this network (CoinMarketCap network id, e.g. `1` = Ethereum, `199` = BNB Smart Chain).

parameters.name: exchange_ids
parameters.description: Only coins listed on any of these exchanges (up to 10 comma-separated CoinMarketCap exchange ids, e.g. `270` = Binance).

parameters.name: age_days_min
parameters.description: Only coins added at least this many days ago.

parameters.name: age_days_max
parameters.description: Only coins added at most this many days ago, e.g. `30` for new listings.

parameters.name: audited
parameters.description: `true`: only projects with a published audit.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Coins per page, 1-200 (default 100).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Top gainers and losers on CoinMarketCap for a timeframe among the top 100, 200, 500 or all coins: rank, name, symbol, slug, price, market cap, 24 h volume, and change for 1 h, 24 h, 7 d and 30 d.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coinmarketcap-movers

parameters.name: timeframe
parameters.description: 1h, 24h (default), 7d or 30d.

parameters.name: rank_range
parameters.description: Among the top 100 (default), 200, 500 or all coins.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Coins per list, 5-100 (default 30).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search CoinMarketCap like its search box: matching coins and tokens (id, name, symbol, slug, rank), exchanges, community topics and accounts, and the number of community posts mentioning the term.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coinmarketcap-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text: a name, symbol or slug.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per type, up to 50 (default 10).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

accounts.biography: Welcome to Bitcoin's Community channel aggregated by CoinMarketCap.

get.description:
The coins most searched on CoinMarketCap right now, in order: rank, name, symbol, slug, price, market cap, 24 h volume and 24 h/7 d/30 d change. `type` switches to the site's other lists: trending, most visited or recently added (those also carry `date_added` and `platforms`), with `type` echoed in the response.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coinmarketcap-trending

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: most_searched (default), trending, most_visited or recently_added.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Coins in the list for trending, most_visited and recently_added, 5-100 (default 30).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
